subsection: Secundum secretam doctrinam sapientum Hebraeorum Cabalistarum
latin_incipit: Cum fiet lux speculi non lucentis sicut speculi lucentis, erit nox sicut
latin_full: Cum fiet lux speculi non lucentis sicut speculi lucentis, erit nox sicut
english_translation:
When the light of the mirror not shining becomes just like that of the

shining mirror, then Night will be just like day, as David says.
english_full:
When the light of the mirror not shining becomes just like that of the

shining mirror, then Night will be just like day, as David says.
